title: Norsine at Allagash in August 1976 running a tag-trace-retrieve exercise

tellings.quote: He said he was doing a TTR um tag trace retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device

plain: Charlie Foltz, a man who says he had a strange experience at the Allagash Waterway, a wilderness river route in Maine, in August 1976, relays what a man named John Norsine told him. According to Foltz, Norsine said he had been running a "tag, trace, retrieve" exercise there that summer, using a small device placed under the skin. If true, it would put a hidden human operation in the same place and time as the experience Foltz describes.
